description: This file defines the HistoryController class for Drupal's History module, handling node read timestamps and comment notifications.

classes.name: HistoryController
classes.description: Controller class for handling history-related routes, including fetching read timestamps, marking nodes as read, and generating comment links.

methods.name: getNodeReadTimestamps
methods.description: Returns last read timestamps for specified nodes, requiring user authentication.

methods.name: readNode
methods.description: Marks a specific node as read by the current user and returns its last read timestamp.

methods.name: renderNewCommentsNodeLinks
methods.description: Generates links for nodes with new comments, limited to 100 nodes, requiring comment module and user authentication.
